plan.status: Planned 4 retention metrics for this quarter
plan.headline: Retention is measured as the share of paying organizations at the start of the quarter that still have an active subscription at its end, with true churn separated from plan changes.

metrics.title: Customer retention rate
metrics.description: Of the organizations with a live paid subscription at the start of the quarter, the share that still have a live paid subscription at the end. Plan changes (upgrade or downgrade) do not count as losses. Compared with the previous quarter.

metrics.title: Net revenue retention
metrics.description: MRR at the end of the quarter from organizations that were paying at the start, divided by their MRR at the start. Includes expansion and contraction from plan changes, and excludes new customers.

metrics.title: Churned customers per week
metrics.description: Number of organizations whose last live subscription ended with a churn cancellation in each week of the quarter, bucketed by cancellation date.

metrics.title: Retention by plan tier
metrics.description: Customer retention rate for the quarter broken down by the plan tier each organization was on at the start of the quarter.

assumptions.label: Period
assumptions.rationale: The question asks about this quarter, so the current quarter to date is compared against the prior quarter.

assumptions.label: Timezone
assumptions.rationale: Cancellation and start timestamps are stored in UTC, so quarter boundaries need one consistent timezone.

assumptions.label: Exclude test orgs
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says QA, demo and load-test tenants should be excluded from business metrics.

assumptions.label: Churn definition
assumptions.rationale: Plan changes close the old subscription row and open a new one, so only cancellations with reason churn count as lost customers, not upgrades or downgrades.

assumptions.label: Count trials
assumptions.rationale: Trials are not yet paying customers, so they are left out of the starting base by default.

events.sql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT (:date_range_start::date) AS d_start,
         LEAST((:date_range_end::date), (:as_of::date) + 1) AS d_end
),
last_sub AS (
  -- each org's most recent subscription row; plan changes open a newer row, so they never surface as the last one
  SELECT s.org_id, s.canceled_at, s.cancel_reason,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.org_id ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC) AS rn
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE NOT (:exclude_test_accounts::boolean AND o.is_test)
),
churned AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', ls.canceled_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text)::date AS week_start,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ls.org_id) AS orgs
  FROM last_sub ls, params p
  WHERE ls.rn = 1
    AND ls.canceled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND (:churn_reasons::text = 'any cancellation' OR ls.cancel_reason = 'churn')
    AND ls.canceled_at >= p.d_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND ls.canceled_at <  p.d_end::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
  GROUP BY 1
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT g::date AS week_start
  FROM params p,
       generate_series(date_trunc('week', p.d_start::timestamp), (p.d_end - 1)::timestamp, interval '1 week') g
)
SELECT w.week_start AS x, COALESCE(c.orgs, 0) AS y
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN churned c ON c.week_start = w.week_start
ORDER BY x
events.explanation: Takes each non-test org's latest subscription, keeps those canceled with a qualifying reason within the period (capped at as_of), and counts distinct orgs per local week, filling empty weeks with zero.

WITH periods AS (
  SELECT 'current' AS p, (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS t0, (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS t1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'previous', (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text, (:date_range_prev_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
),
org_mrr AS (
  -- per org and period: MRR of live paid subscriptions at period start and end
  SELECT p.p, s.org_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr_cents) FILTER (WHERE s.started_at <= p.t0 AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at > p.t0)), 0) AS start_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr_cents) FILTER (WHERE s.started_at <= p.t1 AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at > p.t1)), 0) AS end_mrr
  FROM periods p
  JOIN northwind.subscriptions s ON s.started_at <= p.t1
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test)
    AND (:include_trialing::boolean OR s.status <> 'trialing')
  GROUP BY p.p, s.org_id
),
cohort AS (
  -- only orgs paying at the start; new customers are excluded
  SELECT p, SUM(start_mrr) AS start_mrr, SUM(end_mrr) AS end_mrr
  FROM org_mrr
  WHERE start_mrr > 0
  GROUP BY p
)
SELECT
  (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * end_mrr / NULLIF(start_mrr, 0), 1) FROM cohort WHERE p = 'current') AS value,
  (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * end_mrr / NULLIF(start_mrr, 0), 1) FROM cohort WHERE p = 'previous') AS previous_value
events.explanation: For orgs with live paid MRR at the period start, sums their live MRR at period end (incl. expansion/contraction, excl. new customers) divided by start MRR, for the current and previous quarter.

WITH params AS (
  SELECT (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS start_ts,
         LEAST((:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text,
               ((:as_of::date + 1))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS end_ts
),
subs AS (
  SELECT s.org_id, s.plan_id, s.mrr_cents, s.started_at, s.canceled_at, s.cancel_reason
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test)
    AND (:include_trialing::boolean OR s.status <> 'trialing')
    AND s.mrr_cents > 0
),
start_base AS (
  -- one row per org: its live paid subscription at quarter start (highest MRR if several)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.org_id) s.org_id, s.plan_id
  FROM subs s, params p
  WHERE s.started_at < p.start_ts
    AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= p.start_ts)
  ORDER BY s.org_id, s.mrr_cents DESC, s.plan_id
),
live_at_end AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.org_id
  FROM subs s, params p
  WHERE s.started_at < p.end_ts
    AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= p.end_ts)
),
lost_in_period AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.org_id
  FROM subs s, params p
  WHERE s.canceled_at >= p.start_ts AND s.canceled_at < p.end_ts
    AND (:churn_reasons::text = 'any cancellation' OR s.cancel_reason = 'churn')
),
per_org AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(pl.tier, 'unknown') AS tier,
         CASE WHEN l.org_id IS NOT NULL AND e.org_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS retained
  FROM start_base b
  LEFT JOIN northwind.plans pl ON pl.id = b.plan_id
  LEFT JOIN live_at_end e ON e.org_id = b.org_id
  LEFT JOIN lost_in_period l ON l.org_id = b.org_id
)
SELECT tier AS label,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*), 1) AS value
FROM per_org
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 20
events.explanation: For orgs with a live paid subscription at quarter start, grouped by starting plan tier, the share not lost (no live paid sub at period end after a qualifying cancellation in the period), so plan changes count as retained.

WITH periods AS (
  SELECT 'cur' AS p,
         (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS s,
         (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS e
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'prev',
         (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text,
         (:date_range_prev_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
),
valid_subs AS (
  -- paying subscriptions (trials only if include_trialing) in non-test orgs
  SELECT sub.*
  FROM northwind.subscriptions sub
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = sub.org_id
  WHERE sub.mrr_cents > 0
    AND (sub.status <> 'trialing' OR :include_trialing::boolean)
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test)
),
base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.p, pr.s, pr.e, vs.org_id
  FROM periods pr
  JOIN valid_subs vs
    ON vs.started_at <= pr.s
   AND (vs.canceled_at IS NULL OR vs.canceled_at > pr.s)
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT b.p, b.org_id,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM valid_subs v
      WHERE v.org_id = b.org_id
        AND v.started_at < b.e
        AND (v.canceled_at IS NULL OR v.canceled_at >= b.e)
    ) AS live_at_end,
    (SELECT v.cancel_reason FROM valid_subs v
      WHERE v.org_id = b.org_id AND v.canceled_at IS NOT NULL
        AND v.canceled_at >= b.s AND v.canceled_at < b.e
      ORDER BY v.canceled_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_reason
  FROM base b
),
scored AS (
  SELECT p,
    count(*) AS base_orgs,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (
      NOT live_at_end
      AND (:churn_reasons::text = 'any cancellation' OR last_reason = 'churn')
    )) AS retained_orgs
  FROM flagged
  GROUP BY p
)
SELECT
  (SELECT round(100.0 * retained_orgs / NULLIF(base_orgs, 0), 1) FROM scored WHERE p = 'cur') AS value,
  (SELECT round(100.0 * retained_orgs / NULLIF(base_orgs, 0), 1) FROM scored WHERE p = 'prev') AS previous_value
events.explanation: Takes orgs with a live paying subscription at period start, counts those lost (no live sub at period end and a cancellation matching churn_reasons), and reports retained share for this vs previous quarter.

review.summary: The net revenue retention calculation is sound: point-in-time MRR at quarter start and end, no join duplication, test orgs excluded, and plan changes handled. One caveat is that trial exclusion uses each subscription's current status, so trials that were later canceled can still enter the starting base.

issues.message: The filter s.status <> 'trialing' checks current status only. A trial live at t0 that later ended has status 'canceled', so it counts as paying start MRR and inflates churn. Consider requiring a paid invoice (invoices.status='paid', issued_at <= t0) for start-period subscriptions.
previous_value covers 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-29 (date_range_prev_*), the equal-length window, not full Q3. Label the comparison as 'same point last quarter' so it isn't read as Q3 NRR.

    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr_cents) FILTER (WHERE s.started_at <= p.t1 AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at > p.t1)), 0) AS end_mrr

WITH params AS (
  SELECT (:date_range_start::date) AS d_start,
         LEAST((:date_range_end::date), (:as_of::date) + 1) AS d_end
),
last_sub AS (
  -- each org's most recent subscription row; plan changes open a newer row, so they never surface as the last one
  SELECT s.org_id, s.canceled_at, s.cancel_reason,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.org_id ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC) AS rn
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id

),
churned AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', ls.canceled_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text)::date AS week_start,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ls.org_id) AS orgs
  FROM last_sub ls, params p
  WHERE ls.rn = 1
    AND ls.canceled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND (:churn_reasons::text = 'any cancellation' OR ls.cancel_reason = 'churn')
    AND ls.canceled_at >= p.d_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND ls.canceled_at <  p.d_end::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
  GROUP BY 1
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT g::date AS week_start
  FROM params p,
       generate_series(date_trunc('week', p.d_start::timestamp), (p.d_end - 1)::timestamp, interval '1 week') g
)
SELECT w.week_start AS x, COALESCE(c.orgs, 0) AS y
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN churned c ON c.week_start = w.week_start
ORDER BY x

WITH params AS (
  SELECT (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS start_ts,
         LEAST((:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text,
               ((:as_of::date + 1))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS end_ts
),
subs AS (
  SELECT s.org_id, s.plan_id, s.mrr_cents, s.started_at, s.canceled_at, s.cancel_reason
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test)
    AND (:include_trialing::boolean OR s.status <> 'trialing')
    AND s.mrr_cents > 0
),
start_base AS (
  -- one row per org: its live paid subscription at quarter start (highest MRR if several)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.org_id) s.org_id, s.plan_id
  FROM subs s, params p
  WHERE s.started_at < p.start_ts
    AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= p.start_ts)
  ORDER BY s.org_id, s.mrr_cents DESC, s.plan_id
),
live_at_end AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.org_id
  FROM subs s, params p
  WHERE s.started_at < p.end_ts
    AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= p.end_ts)
),
lost_in_period AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.org_id
  FROM subs s, params p
  WHERE s.canceled_at >= p.start_ts AND s.canceled_at < p.end_ts
    AND (:churn_reasons::text = 'any cancellation' OR s.cancel_reason = 'churn')
),
per_org AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(pl.tier, 'unknown') AS tier,
         CASE WHEN l.org_id IS NOT NULL AND e.org_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS retained
  FROM start_base b
  LEFT JOIN northwind.plans pl ON pl.id = b.plan_id
  LEFT JOIN live_at_end e ON e.org_id = b.org_id
  LEFT JOIN lost_in_period l ON l.org_id = b.org_id
)
SELECT tier AS label,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*), 1) AS value
FROM per_org
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 20

review.summary: The retention rate is broadly correct, but a canceled subscription with no cancel_reason is counted as retained, which could slightly overstate retention.

issues.message: In flagged/scored, an org that is not live at the end and whose last cancellation has NULL subscriptions.cancel_reason counts as retained; treat any reason other than upgrade or downgrade as a loss (COALESCE(last_reason,'churn')).

Orgs whose last paid row closed with cancel_reason upgrade/downgrade count as retained even with no paid sub live at end (e.g. downgrade to an mrr_cents = 0 plan); this matches the churn_reasons assumption but is worth surfacing.
